subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should #101026 be split so Feishu outbound hook parity lands first while normal-channel `inbound_claim` expansion stays on a separate plugin API/security track?
rationale: Current source supports the Feishu outbound bypass as a P1 bug, but broadening `inbound_claim` changes claim authority and cannot be decided from source inspection alone.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound_claim
options.body: Fix Feishu auto-reply/comment dispatcher hook composition now and leave normal-channel `inbound_claim` to a separate owner-reviewed API/security issue.

options.title: Fold all hook changes into one PR
options.body: Require one broader PR to solve outbound parity and `inbound_claim`, accepting slower review and higher exactly-once/security risk.

options.title: Defer to broader hook trackers
options.body: Keep #101026 as dependent on #92374/#50126 only, which avoids a Feishu-local patch but leaves the reported downstream plugin breakage unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound_claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu auto-reply/comment dispatcher hook composition now and leave normal-channel `inbound_claim` to a separate owner-reviewed API/security issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily plugin hook API semantics and security-sensitive claim behavior, where the issue discussion and plugin-surface history point to vincentkoc as the best routing owner.
